question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.5.
solution:
The correct answer is 'a precedent'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look at the **meaning **of the given options - 

 
 
• an incentive - a thing that motivates or encourages someone to do something.
 
• a citation - a quotation from or reference to a book, paper, or author, especially in a scholarly work.
 
• an instance - an example or single occurrence of something.
 
• a precedent - an earlier event or action that is regarded as an example or guide to be considered in subsequent similar circumstances.
 
 
 
• The given sentence expresses the fact that Indians can follow their rich culture and simple life and thus, they can set an example for the west to see that India is much more than a well of business opportunities.
 
• From the meanings of the given words, it is clear that a precedent fits the blank correctly. 
 
• Thus, option 4 is the correct answer. 

 

**Correct passage**__* - **Concerned and responsible Indian citizens can encourage sensible consumption (1) behaviour. This can be done by shopping less and wasting (2) even lesser; by buying local products to keep the cottage industries and (3) traditional crafts alive. In essence, by valuing their rich(4) heritage and living simple and meaningful lives, Indians can set (5) __**a precedent**__ and show the west that India is much more than a well of business opportunities.*
